profiles.label: duckdb-commerce-1.5.6

diagnostics.message: Native acquisition does not establish invariance for a runtime-sized fragment list.

profiles.method: Actual native acquisition and independent reconciliation of the maintained commerce corpus. Copy zero is unchanged; later copies add comments only, stressing exact-SQL identity. No candidate is bound, stepped or supplied sample values. Durables/cache measure only qualified admitted subsets, not a complete application. Counts are API acquisitions/context inspections, not protocol round trips. Acquisition/publication time excludes fixture provisioning, introspection, compression, artifact byte reads and offline replay. Offline reload retains unverified freshness. Compression uses gzip level 9 and Brotli quality 11. Measurements are single observations per scale, not latency percentiles or production popularity or full CLI/build timing.
